items.title: 67395_Vic Dickenson oral history interview
items.q: I liked playing with Claude. It was a good band.

ctx.x: Yeah, I guess if you didn't have to go down there, there was no good reason for it.
I was with a band, and what are you going to do? And I liked playing with Claude. It was a good band.
That was sort of a... I don't know if you'd say soft, but sort of like a pretty band. Right?
